headline: Alignerr Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: Alignerr review covering roles, pay ranges, the Zara interview and Labelbox onboarding, and community-reported experiences.

acceptedAnswer.text: Alignerr pays contributors to evaluate and improve AI content and recruits domain experts to design expert-level tasks for advanced AI agents.
Alignerr is powered by Labelbox, a major AI data infrastructure company.

mainEntity.name: How much does Alignerr pay per hour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Advertised up to $150/hr; Search Quality Evaluator pays $40-$120/hr; community-reported general rates run $15-$60/hr.

mainEntity.name: How long does Alignerr's hiring process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: An average of 28 days across all job titles, based on user-submitted interview data.

mainEntity.name: Does Alignerr require a technical background?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not for generalist or Search Quality Evaluator roles; Software Engineer/AI Code Evaluator roles require 3-4+ years of professional experience.

mainEntity.name: Is the Alignerr hiring process entirely AI-driven?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, according to community reports, though this isn't clearly disclosed in the platform's public hiring announcements.

mainEntity.name: Does Alignerr have silent account deletions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Community reports describe silent account deletions and workers sitting idle for months without explanation.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods does Alignerr use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stripe Connect and PayPal, depending on location.

mainEntity.name: How difficult is the Alignerr assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Glassdoor reviewers rated interview difficulty at 2.88 out of 5 on average, with AI Evaluator and Software Engineer roles rated hardest.
